texts.zh: 我们的舰队摧毁了[From.GetName]的总部。从他们的太空基地的残骸中尽可能回收有价值物资的行动也已如火如荼地展开。我们已经获得了大量资源。
texts.en: Our fleet assets have destroyed the [From.GetName] headquarters. Efforts are well under way to recover as many valuables as possible from the shattered remnants of their starbase. We have gained a large amount of resources.

texts.zh:
欢迎光临雪拉企业！

我们是在[trader_system.GetName]恒星系对外运营的商业联合企业，主营贸易——我们雪拉企业坚信，贸易是文明的基石。

如果您想进行贸易的话，请联系我们，我们会尽量满足您的一切需要。
texts.en:
Welcome to XuraCorp!

We are a business conglomerate operating out of the [trader_system.GetName] system, specializing in trade - the very building blocks of civilization, as we like to say here at XuraCorp.

Please, do not hesitate to contact us if you're interested in making a good deal.

texts.zh:
我是里甘商业交易所的代表。我们以[trader_system.GetName]的空间站为基地，负责帮助各个团体建立完善的贸易渠道以达千年。

如果您手头有多余的资源想要出售，找我们就对了，我们提供的价格保证让您满意。
texts.en:
I speak on behalf of the Riggan Commerce Exchange. We have facilitated trade negotiations between interested parties on our station in the [trader_system.GetName] system for more than a thousand of your years.

If you happen to possess more resources than you need, we are more than willing to take it off your hands. You will be duly compensated, of course.

texts.zh:
很高兴见到你们，朋友们！我代表穆塔根商人公会欢迎你们来到[trader_system.GetName]恒星系。我们公会由数百位独立的穆塔根商船舰长组成，他们勇敢地在太空中探索，寻找商机。

您可以在我们的机构中出售多余的资源。如果您有意出售，请随时联系我们。
texts.en:
Well met, friends! I represent the Muutagan Merchant Guild, and let me be the first to welcome you to the [trader_system.GetName] system. Our organization consists of hundreds of independent Muutagan merchant captains who brave the spaceways in search of the next good deal.

At our facilities, you will be able to trade away some of your excess resources. Please contact us if you are interested in such an arrangement.

texts.zh: 雪拉企业不会对任何客户抱有偏见。毕竟我们何德何能去对您的道德准则品头论足呢？
texts.en: We do not discriminate against prospective buyers here at XuraCorp. Who are we to judge the morals of your star nation?

texts.zh: 您可能需要矿物来建造战舰，或者用它们来建造孤儿院！在雪拉企业，我们绝不会过问您打算如何使用我们的商品！
texts.en: Perhaps you need minerals for building warships. Perhaps you need them for building orphanages! Here at XuraCorp, we make it our business not to care!

texts.zh: 我们绝不过问任何事情——我们只提供品质精良的物资，保证让您十分满意，时刻准备着为您的工业建设输送新鲜血液!
texts.en: No questions asked - just quality resources, ready to be pumped right into the arteries of your industry!

texts.zh: 恕不退款，十分抱歉。这是公司的政策……这超出了我们的[xuracorp_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]掌控的范围。
texts.en: No refunds, I'm afraid. Company policy... It's out of my [xuracorp_country.species.GetHandNamePlural].

texts.zh: 客官您对本公司的非品牌蒸馏装备感兴趣吗？并不？那么微粒检测器呢？
texts.en: Can we interest you in some off-brand distillation equipment? No? How about particulate detectors?

texts.zh: 欢迎联系雪拉企业，请问您需要什么服务呢？
texts.en: You have reached XuraCorp. How may we help you?

label.zh: 我们对战略资源有兴趣。
label.en: We are interested in Strategic Resources.

label.zh: 我们打算雇佣一位顾问。
label.en: We wish to hire a consultant.

label.zh: 我们希望结束资源贸易协定。
label.en: We wish to end our resource trade deal.

texts.zh: 我们的所有客户都是匿名交易的。
texts.en: All of our clients remain anonymous.

texts.zh: 您想知道我们的资源是从哪里来的？很抱歉……出于对所有客户——包括[Root.GetName]——的利益考虑，我们的货源必须要保密……
texts.en: Where do our resources come from? Trust me... It's best for all involved parties - including the [Root.GetName] - if we keep that little bit of information to ourselves...

texts.zh: 我们不从事奴隶交易，绝不开先例。很抱歉。
texts.en: We do not deal in slaves. Sorry, no exceptions.

texts.zh: 里甘商业交易所欢迎您的到来。
texts.en: The Riggan Commerce Exchange greets you.

texts.zh: 千年老字号，诚信又可靠。
texts.en: A thousand years and we are still in business. If that doesn't speak to our credibility, I don't know what will.

texts.zh: 数个驻扎在我们空间站的势力希望与[Root.GetName]贸易磋商，阁下的意见是？
texts.en: Several parties on our starbase have expressed interest in dealing with the [Root.GetName]. Shall we negotiate a deal?

label.zh: 我们对战略资源有兴趣。
label.en: We are interested in Strategic Resources.

label.zh: 我们打算雇佣一位顾问。
label.en: We wish to hire a consultant.

label.zh: 我们希望结束资源贸易协定。
label.en: We wish to end our resource trade deal.

texts.zh: 千年之前，穆塔根帝国从浩瀚星系之中汲取惊人财富，然而现在我们这个小小的财阀成了帝国的唯一遗产。
texts.en: Thousands of years ago, the Muutagan Empire spanned a good portion of the galaxy. We are all that remain.

texts.zh: 有传言穆塔根人可以敏锐地嗅到十二个秒差距以外的商机，这种说法实在是有些夸张了……说真的，最远只有八个秒差距而已。
texts.en: It is said that a Muutagan can smell a good deal from a distance of twelve parsecs. This is an exaggeration... In truth, the distance is only eight parsecs.

texts.zh: 穆塔根商人公会欢迎您，打算来一发交易吗？
texts.en: The Muutagan Merchant Guild welcomes you. Would you like to make a deal?

texts.zh: 一个穆塔根人和一个雷西达伦人一起走进一间酒吧……算了，当我没说，这么交流实在欠妥，请您原谅。
texts.en: A Muutagan and a Rixidaran walk into a bar... Never mind, this does not make for appropriate conversation. I beg your forgiveness.

texts.zh: 您好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。您是来这里找我们交易的吗？
texts.en: Greetings, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. You are here to trade with us, yes?

texts.zh: "折扣"这个词对于我们的人民来说是一种亵渎。在和我们交流的时候请谨记这一点。
texts.en: The word "discount" is considered a profanity among my people. Please keep this in mind when engaging in conversation with us.

label.zh: 我们对战略资源有兴趣。
label.en: We are interested in Strategic Resources.

label.zh: 我们打算雇佣一位顾问。
label.en: We wish to hire a consultant.

label.zh: 我们希望结束资源贸易协定。
label.en: We wish to end our resource trade deal.

texts.zh: 我们有一位才华横溢的执行经理随时待命，准备前往[Root.GetName]，解决您任何一片星域的困境。£trade£贸易额的事就交给专家来解决吧！
texts.en: We have a talented executive standing by, ready to migrate to the [Root.GetName] and get any of your sectors back out of the red. Entrust your £trade£ Trade to an expert!

texts.zh:
我们有一位才华横溢的高管随时待命，准备……嗯？你说什么？

“买方须知”很好，但是我还是有义务通知您，我们的顾问真的只专注于£trade£贸易额。我不确定这是否适合你，毕竟……您与这一概念似乎有些格格不入。
texts.en:
We have a talented executive standing by, ready to... Hm. Are you sure?

'Buyer beware' is all well and good, but still: I feel obliged to inform you that our consultants really only specialize in £trade£ Trade. I'm not sure they would be a good fit for you, given your... unusual relationship with that concept.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

texts.zh:
这是我们雪拉企业引以为傲的产品。我们的医疗部门最近开始精炼一种性质独特的气体，可以使适应外星环境的艰难过程变得轻松不少。不过它很可能无法与外星生理机能相容！

我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口异星天然气，之后我们就必须重新签订协议。
texts.en:
This is a product that we here at XuraCorp are particularly proud of. Our Medical Division has recently begun refining a gas with unique properties that will significantly ease the often difficult process of adapting to a foreign planetary environment. It is however unlikely to be compatible with alien physiology!

We are willing to export our Exotic Gas to you for a period of ten standard years, after which the contract will have to be renegotiated.

texts.zh:
这种易爆微粒是里甘的珍贵调味料。它以独一无二的味道在宇宙中声名远扬——它独一无二的爆炸性也同样声名远扬。我们只卖给最宝贵的贸易伙伴，[Root.GetName]便是其一。

只要你接受这合理的价格，我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口易爆微粒。
texts.en:
The Volatile Mote is a prized Riggan condiment. It is renowned throughout the galaxy for its distinct flavor, which is unlike any other - and its explosiveness, which is also unlike any other. We sell it only to our most valued trading partners, among which we count the [Root.GetName].

If you can meet our modest price, we are willing to export Volatile Motes to you for a period of ten standard years.

texts.zh:
史拉卡-杜——也被我族之外的人称为稀有水晶——已经成了我们整个文明的象征。当这些“歌唱”水晶震动时，会散发一种独特的旋律，可对大多数智慧生物起到镇静作用。

尽管我们通常不会与外人分享史拉卡杜的神奇，但可以为你开个特例。如果你付得起，我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口我们的水晶。
texts.en:
Shi'rakkat-Du - or Rare Crystals as they are known to those who are not of our species - have come to symbolize our entire civilization. When these "singing" crystals vibrate, they emit a unique musical tone that has a calming effect on most sapients.

Although we typically do not share the wonders of the Shi'rakkat-Du with outsiders, we are willing to make an exception in your case. If you can afford it, we are willing to export our crystals to you for a period of ten years.

texts.zh:
雪拉企业就该这样做生意啊！我们的货船会马上开始发货。

如果您购买了这个产品，也就等同于默认雪拉企业将不对使用这个产品所产生的任何副作用负责，这包括但不限于皮肤刺激，精神病发作，眼球变色，侵略性的突变，殖民地居民自杀率增加，预知恍惚，生物圈资源耗尽，高危奇异物质产生，微型黑洞生成，谷物升降机爆炸，社会崩溃，大规模灭绝事件，意外的超新星爆炸，局部或全面的星际帝国崩溃、突发的伽玛射线暴，时间旅行悖论，真空亚稳态事件，通用熵，时空连续性的崩溃……
texts.en:
That's the XuraCorp way! Our freighters will begin making deliveries immediately.

By purchasing this product, you agree that XuraCorp cannot be held responsible for any adverse effects that may result from its use, including but not limited to: skin irritation, psychotic episodes, ocular discoloration, aggressive mutation, increased colonist suicide rates, precognitive trances, biosphere depletion, dangerous strangelet production, micro black hole generation, grain elevator explosions, societal collapse, mass extinction events, unexpected supernova detonations, the complete or partial destruction of your star nation, sudden gamma-ray bursts, time travel paradoxes, vacuum metastability events, universal entropy, the collapse of the space-time continuum...

texts.zh: 你不会后悔的，除非您吃了太多香料……那样的话您会有很小的几率发生自燃，不过也只有很小的几率，我很肯定。
texts.en: You will not be sorry. Unless you consume too much spice, of course... Then there is a small chance that you will spontaneously combust. A very small chance, to be sure.

texts.zh: 很好。我们的商人将立即向你的殖民地运送水晶。愿史拉卡杜对你歌唱。
texts.en: Excellent. Our merchants will begin shipping the crystals to your colonies at once. May the Shi'rakkat-Du sing to you.

texts.zh: 位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的雪拉企业的总部最近被摧毁了。 有报告认为袭击者来自[trader_destroyer.GetName]！ 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。
texts.en: The corporate headquarters of XuraCorp in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. Reports suggest the attack force belongs to the [trader_destroyer.GetName]! The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

texts.zh: 位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的雪拉企业的总部最近被摧毁了。 根据我们的情报，这次行动是由我们尚未知晓的势力进行的。 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。
texts.en: The corporate headquarters of XuraCorp in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. According to our intel, this act was perpetrated by forces as yet unknown to us. The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

texts.zh:
位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的雪拉企业的总部最近被摧毁了。 有报告认为袭击者来自[trader_destroyer.GetName]！ 少数幸存的董事会成员已宣布破产，该公司的剩余资产正在进行清算。

不幸的是，雪拉集团总部的异星天然气生产设施被摧毁，我们失去了这一战略资源的获取渠道。
texts.en:
The corporate headquarters of XuraCorp in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. Reports suggest the attack force belongs to the [trader_destroyer.GetName]! The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

Unfortunately, their production facilities for the Exotic Gas were destroyed along with the XuraCorp HQ, and we will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.

不幸的是，雪拉集团总部的异星天然气生产设施被摧毁，我们失去了这一战略资源的获取渠道。
texts.en:
The corporate headquarters of XuraCorp in the [trader_system.GetName] system was recently destroyed. According to our intel, this act was perpetrated by forces as yet unknown to us. The few surviving board members have declared bankruptcy, and the corporation's remaining assets are being liquidated.

Unfortunately, their production facilities for the Exotic Gas were destroyed along with the XuraCorp HQ, and we will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.

label.zh: 这是对自由贸易的狠狠一击。

texts.zh: 属于里甘商业交易所的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 是[trader_destroyer.GetName]做的好事。
texts.en: The starbase belonging to the Riggan Commerce Exchange has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. The forces of the [trader_destroyer.GetName] made certain of that.

texts.zh: 属于里甘商业交易所的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 袭击者的来路不明。
texts.en: The starbase belonging to the Riggan Commerce Exchange has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. Forces from an unidentified aggressor have made certain of that.

texts.zh:
属于里甘商业交易所的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 是[trader_destroyer.GetName]做的好事。

不幸的是，这也消除了这一处易爆微粒的来源，我们失去了这一战略资源的获取渠道。
texts.en:
The starbase belonging to the Riggan Commerce Exchange has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. The forces of the [trader_destroyer.GetName] made certain of that.

Unfortunately, this has also eliminated a source of Volatile Motes. We will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.

属于里甘商业交易所的恒星基地在[trader_system.GetName]星系被毁。这个自由前哨已经为星际文明之间的贸易提供便利超过一个千年，但如今已不复存在。 袭击者的来路不明。

不幸的是，这也消除了这一处易爆微粒的来源，我们失去了这一战略资源的获取渠道。

The starbase belonging to the Riggan Commerce Exchange has been destroyed in the [trader_system.GetName] system. This free outpost had facilitated trade between interstellar civilizations for over a millennium, but no longer. Forces from an unidentified aggressor have made certain of that.

Unfortunately, this has also eliminated a source of Volatile Motes. We will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.

texts.zh: 有报告说位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的穆塔根商人公会的总部被摧毁了。 看来这次袭击的背后是隶属于[trader_destroyer.GetName]的势力。 存活下来的少数穆塔根商队舰长四散于全星系中。
texts.en: Reports are coming in that the headquarters of the Muutagan Merchant Guild in the [trader_system.GetName] system has been pulverized. Forces belonging to the [trader_destroyer.GetName] appear to be behind this attack. The few surviving Muutagan merchant captains have scattered across the galaxy.

texts.zh: 有报告说位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的穆塔根商人公会的总部被摧毁了。 这些袭击者似乎来自于一个我们尚未知晓的帝国。 存活下来的少数穆塔根商队舰长四散于全星系中。
texts.en: Reports are coming in that the headquarters of the Muutagan Merchant Guild in the [trader_system.GetName] system has been pulverized. The attackers appear to hail from an empire which is, as yet, unknown to us. The few surviving Muutagan merchant captains have scattered across the galaxy.

texts.zh:
有报告说位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的穆塔根商人公会的总部被摧毁了。 看来这次袭击的背后是隶属于[trader_destroyer.GetName]的势力。 存活下来的少数穆塔根商队舰长四散于全星系中。

不幸的是，这意味着他们已经无法继续生产珍贵的稀有水晶了，我们失去了这一战略资源的获取渠道。
texts.en:
Reports are coming in that the headquarters of the Muutagan Merchant Guild in the [trader_system.GetName] system has been pulverized. Forces belonging to the [trader_destroyer.GetName] appear to be behind this attack. The few surviving Muutagan merchant captains have scattered across the galaxy.

Unfortunately, this means an end to their production of the prized Rare Crystals. We will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.

texts.zh:
有报告说位于[trader_system.GetName]星系的穆塔根商人公会的总部被摧毁了。 这些袭击者似乎来自于一个我们尚未知晓的帝国。 存活下来的少数穆塔根商队舰长四散于全星系中。

不幸的是，这意味着他们已经无法继续生产珍贵的稀有水晶了，我们失去了这一战略资源的获取渠道。
texts.en:
Reports are coming in that the headquarters of the Muutagan Merchant Guild in the [trader_system.GetName] system has been pulverized. The attackers appear to hail from an empire which is, as yet, unknown to us. The few surviving Muutagan merchant captains have scattered across the galaxy.

Unfortunately, this means an end to their production of the prized Rare Crystals. We will no longer have access to this strategic resource channel.

texts.zh: 亲爱的客户，我们很遗憾的通知你，我们同[Root.GetName]的异星天然气协定已经到期。如果你有多余的能量币，我们当然愿意再延长十年的交易…
texts.en: Dearest customer, we regret to inform you that the trade deal we negotiated for the export of Exotic Gas to the worlds of the [Root.GetName] has run its course. We are of course more than willing to extend the deal for another ten years if you have the energy credits to spare...

label.zh: 很好。我们希望延长这笔交易。
label.en: Very well. We wish to extend the deal.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

label.zh: 我们现在用不着你们的气体了。
label.en: We can do without your gas for now.

texts.zh: 我们的协议已经到期，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们在过去的十年里向你运送了易爆微粒。请问你想续约亦或者结束这一安排？
texts.en: We have reached the end of our agreement, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We have shipped Volatile Motes to your worlds for ten years. Should we continue for another ten, or do you wish to end this arrangement?

label.zh: 让我们继续，这些微粒应当保持流通。
label.en: Let us continue. The motes must flow.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

label.zh: 我们现在不需要你的香料了。
label.en: We have no need of your spice for now.

texts.zh: 时光易逝，不是吗，[Root.GetSpeciesName]？我们之间的稀有水晶贸易已经十年了。你希望再签署一个十年的贸易协定么？
texts.en: The years just fly by, don't they, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? It has now been ten years since we arranged our trade deal for Rare Crystals. Do you wish to extend the deal for another decade?

label.zh: 是的。让我们继续这个交易。
label.en: Yes. Let us continue this deal.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

label.zh: 我们现在不需要你们的水晶了。
label.en: We will pass on your crystals for now.

texts.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击将雪拉企业的财产和雇员置于危险当中，我们别无选择，只能终止我们之间的贸易协定，而且我们不会退款。
texts.en: Your reckless attacks have put XuraCorp property and employees at risk. We have no choice but to terminate our current trade agreement. There will be no refunds.

texts.zh: 你们鲁莽的袭击威胁到了雪拉企业的财产和雇员的安全。最好记住，良好的客户关系是双向的。
texts.en: Your reckless attack endangers XuraCorp property and employees alike. You would do well to remember that good customer relations go both ways.

texts.zh: 很抱歉，根据公司规定，我们不能和海盗进行贸易。
texts.en: I'm afraid it's against company policy to do business with pirates.

texts.zh: 我们不能接受你们这样的客户。
texts.en: You are not an acceptable customer.

texts.zh: 我们和你们没什么好谈的。
texts.en: We have nothing to discuss with you.

texts.zh: 你们竟然对我们的太空站发动袭击，不可原谅！我们不会再给你们运送货物了，明白吗？不会再给你们运送辛香料了！我们之间的贸易协定就此作废。
texts.en: Your attacks against our station are intolerable! You are cut off, do you understand? You may consider our trade agreement null and void.

texts.zh: 这次攻击无缘无故，毫无理由！我们绝不会容忍这样的行径！请你自行挂断吧。
texts.en: This attack is unprovoked and uncalled for! We will not stand for it. Consider yourselves cut off.

texts.zh: 你们的人全是强盗和恶徒，我们将和你们彻底撇清关系。
texts.en: You are a nation of bandits and cutthroats. We will have nothing to do with you.

texts.zh: 海盗鼠辈。
texts.en: Pirate scum.

texts.zh: 你们的进攻行为是不可原谅的。
texts.en: Your attacks are unforgivable.

texts.zh: 啊，海盗终于展现出本来面目了！你们别想再从我们这里得到水晶了！任何一个穆塔根人都不会再和[Root.GetName]做交易了。
texts.en: Ah, so the pirates shows their true colors! You can forget about our trade deals! No Muutagan will do business with the [Root.GetName] again.

texts.zh: 你竟敢攻击我们？搞清楚点，你这海盗：我们最瞧不起的就是这样的野蛮行径。
texts.en: You dare to attack us?! Know this, pirates: we do not stand for such barbarism.

texts.zh: 你们这群破坏分子！我们是不会忘记你们的残酷行径的。
texts.en: You are terrorists! Do not think we will forget your aggression against our people.

texts.zh: 穆塔根人可是很记仇的，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。我们绝不会忘记你们的恶行。
texts.en: You will find that Muutagans have very long memories, [Root.GetSpeciesName]. We never forget a slight.

texts.zh: 我们再也不会信任[Root.GetName]了。
texts.en: We will never trust the [Root.GetName] again.
